tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ni gu chos drug gi sgo nas bka' so so'i phyag len bzlas chog gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so// bla ma yi dam chos skyong la/ /gus btud mchod pas mnyes byas nas/ /gang zhig snod ldan brgyud bcas don/ /byin rlabs cho ga'i gsal byed bri/ /de la 'dir sgyu lus dbang mo cher grags pa ni kun mkhyen gangs khrod pa'i yi ge sor bzhag mdzad/ ༈ de nas thabs lam gyi dbang bskur na/ rdul mtshon gyi maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab bzhi lte ba ser/ 'dab ma phyogs tshon/ dbus su tshon spungs sngon po/ mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang gtor ma bshams/ bgegs gtor gcig kyang logs su bshams/ de nas slob dpon gyis skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas rang nyid bde mchog lhan skyes yab yum gyi bskyed chog gzhung bzhin bya/ gnas gsum byin rlabs ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim/ yi ge bdun ma nyer gcig la sogs pa bzla/ bdag bskyed 'di byin rlabs gzhan phal cher la yang rigs 'gre/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal la dmigs te sum bha nis bgegs bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su seng khri pad+ma nyi zla 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i steng du bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bde mchog lhan skyes yab yum la snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhis bskor ba sgyu lus dbang mo che'i skabs bzhin bskyed/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes kyi lha spyan drangs nas bstim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ bha ra maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri wa re ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du mtshan sngags re re'i mthar pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe sogs sbyar te mchod/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi nang mchod/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las zhes pa nas/ kun bzang he ru ka'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ gtor ma la dmigs te oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi bdud rtsir byin rlabs la mtshan sngags gyi mthar/

na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ phyi nang gis mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la bdag dang slob mar bcas pa rnams kyi rgyud byin gyis brlabs te rtogs pa khyad par can skye bar mdzad du gsol/ spyi bor bde mchog lha lnga bskyed pa nas dbang bzhi pa'i bar slob ma la ji ltar bya ba bzhin rang nyid kyis kyang blang / de nas slob ma mdun du 'khod pa la dmigs nas/ sarba bigh+nan na ma sarba sogs lan gsum gyis bgegs la gtor ma bsngos la rdo rje gsor/ dril bu bsil zhing 'dir byin rlabs kyi bka' nod pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren rnams gtor ma 'di khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas pa gzhan du song zhig ces brjod la gtor ma phyir dor/ sum+bha ni brjod 'di byin rlabs gzhan kun la'ang rigs 'gre/ de nas sems can thams cad kyi don du zhes sogs sems bskyed brda sprad/ thabs lam gyi sgo nas bka' zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug dga' chen khyod bdag sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan snga na yar bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib rnams mthol zhing bshags snyam pa dang / rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa la rjes su yi rang snyam pa'i dga' ba bsgom pa/ dus da nas bzung byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa'i smon pa sems bskyed pa dang / sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir du lam la slob snyam pa 'jug pa sems bskyed pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ci byas thams cad sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig snyam pa'i bsngo ba ste de rnams gsal btab pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos gsung ba zhu/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs lan gsum/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag rnam smin gdos bcas kyi phung po gtsang sing sbyangs te 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ de la dmigs te oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas phung khams skye mched la sogs pa snang zhing srid pa'i chos thams cad dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du khyed rang rnams skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhes sogs yum dang bcas pa'i bskyed chog dkyus bzhin/ de'i dpral bar oṃ sogs gnas gsum byin rlabs/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad bde mchog lha lnga'i rnam par byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la sib sib thim pas thugs rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril lam dril bsil dang bstun la yi ge bdun pa'i mthar a bh+ya sha ya a a a btags pa tshar ci rigs brjod/ ye shes dbab pa 'di yang byin rlabs kun la rigs 'gre/ dbang dngos gzhi'i slad du thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang ba zhu/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor pad zla'i steng du bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po yum bcas snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhis bskor ba bskyed chog bzhin gsal btab/ de'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam par byon nas spyi bo'i bla ma la thim/ bla ma de la rang gi lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge rtsa thams cad phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i rnam par bsgyur nas phul bas thugs mnyes par byas pa'i mos pa gnang / gsol ba btab pa 'di yang gsung ba zhu/

bla ma rin po che bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ lan gsum/ spyi bo'i bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun skya nar nar byung spyi bor thim pas smin mtshams yan chad gang lus kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag bum pa'i dbang thob snyam pa'i mos pa gnang ba zhu/ ḍā dril dang yi ge bdun pa'i mthar rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig myur ba nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig 'dug sa 'di nyid du byin gyi rlobs shig ces brjod/ yang sngar gyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun de mgrin par slebs te mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor thams cad gang / ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsang ba'i dbang thob snyam pa'i mos pa gnang ba zhu/ ḍā dril yi ge bdun pa sogs sngar bzhin/ yang bdud rtsi'i rgyun de snying gar slebs te de'i rtsa 'khor thams cad gang / yid kyi sgrib pa dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob snyam pa sogs 'dra/ yang bdud rtsi'i rgyun de lte bar slebs te de'i rtsa 'khor thams cad gang bas sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa dag dbang bzhi pa thob snyam pa sogs 'dra/ rjes gtso bos sogs spyi dang 'dra/ slar slob dpon gyi mdun bskyed la mchod bstod byas la yig brgya tshar gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod gsol badz+ra muḥ rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hos bstim/ ras bris yin na brtan bzhugs bya/ dge ba bsngo// ༈ sgyu lus kyi dbang bskur ba'i tshe maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab bzhi'am 'dab brgyad gang rung gsungs kyang 'dab brgyad phyag len la mdzad/ lte ba dang shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang mtshams bzhi mdzes tshon/ mchod gtor sogs sngar bzhin/ slob dpon rang nyid skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas skad cig gis pad nyi'i steng du kye rdor zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum bdag med ma sngon po gri thod can dang mnyam par sbyor ba/

gnas gsum byin rlabs la ye shes pa bstim/ de wa pi tsu nyer gcig la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ mdun bskyed kyi maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes rang snang gi gzhal yas khang gi dbus pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar seng khri pad nyi tshangs pa brgya byin gyi steng du kye rdor gong bzhin/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du gau rī/ lhor tsau rī/ nub tu bai ta lī/ byang du ghasma rī/ byang shar du puk+ka sī/ shar lhor ri khrod mā/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo/ nub byang du g.yung mo rnams bskyed chog ji lta ba bzhin nam/ mtshan tsam brjod pas kyang chog shrī he badz+ra maṇ+ḍal sa pa ri wa ri zhes pa'i mtshan sngags/ ar+ghaṃ sogs re re'i dbur sbyar te mchod/ shap+ta nas dril bsil bya zhing / dharmā ra ṇi ta brjod/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi nang mchod/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma 'bul tshul thabs lam gyi skabs kyi 'gros sbyar bas shes/ de nas rang gi spyi bor pad+ma 'dab brgyad pad nyi dang bcas pa'i steng du kye rdor lha dgu gsal btab pa nas bzung dbang bzhi pa'i bar 'og tu slob ma la ji ltar bya ba bzhin blangs/ de nas bgegs gtor dkyus bzhin/ maṇ+ḍal gsol btab/ rgyun bshags/ slob ma kye rdor du bskyed pa la ye shes dbab pa rnams sngar gyi 'gros sbyar bas shes/ dngos gzhi la thugs 'dun dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gnang ba zhu/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor pad nyi'i steng du bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i kye rdor yab yum bzhugs pa'i mos pa gnang / lus kyi gsang gnas nas bzung dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma dkar gsal yas sne tshangs bug tu kha gshags te phye ba dbu ma'i mas snar yi ge raṃ gcig gsal gdab/ spyi bo'i bla ma la phyi nang gsang gsum gyis mchod pa phul la/ bla ma rin po che bdag la zhes sogs sngar gyi gsol btab de lan gsum/ dbu ma'i mas sna'i raṃ la gtum mo ye shes kyi me sbar nas dbu ma'i nang na yar song /

spyi bo'i bla ma kye rdo rje la reg pas de'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ spyi bo'i bla ma'i thugs kar zhugs pa dang sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gi spyi bo'i dbu ma na mar song bas bde ba skyes/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag bum pa'i dbang thob sogs 'dra/ ḍā dril dang de wa pi tsu/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i sogs sngar bzhin yang thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang ba zhu/ spyi bo'i bla ma yab yum snyoms 'jug byas pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang sems dkar dmar babs/ spyi bo nas song / mgrin pa'i dbu ma khengs te/ bde ba skyes/ gsang ba'i dbang thob snyam pa dang ḍā dril sogs 'dra/ yang spyi bo'i lha la yid kyis mchod pa phul bas yum gyi thugs kha nas yum gcig byung ste khyed rang kye rdor du gsal ba dang snyoms 'jug byas pas yum dang rang bde ba rgyas shing 'od kyi rnam par gyur pas zag med kyi bde ba skyes te yid kyi sdig sgrib dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob snyam pa dang ḍā dril sogs 'dra/ yang thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang ba zhu/ khyed rang kye rdor yab yum du gsal ba'i yum rang la thim/ rang nyid 'od du yal song ste sems ma bcos pa'i ngang la dar gcig 'jog pa zhu/ ḍā dril sogs 'dra/ des dbang bzhi pa thob pa yin/ rjes gtso bos sogs dang / mdun bskyed la mchod bstod sogs 'dra// ༈ rmi lam gyi dbang bskur ni gnas dben par maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab bzhi/ lte ba dang shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / mchod gtor sogs dkyus bzhin/ slob dpon gyi bdag bskyed bde mchog lhan skyes yab yum dang yi ge bdun pa bzlas pa dkyus bzhin/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes rang snang gi gzhal yas khang gi dbus dang phyogs bzhir pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re/

dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bde mchog lhan skyes yab yum/ shar du dges mdzad rdo rje/ lhor gsang ba 'dus pa/ nub tu mahā mā yā/ byang du rdo rje 'jigs byed rnams yam yum dang bcas pa sgyu lus dbang mo che'i skabs bzhin bskyed/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa bcug oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri wa re sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi nang mchod/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las sogs sam/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ btags pa sogs kyis 'bul/ des slob dpon rang gi spyi bo sogs gnas bzhir hūm̐ dang hrī la sogs pa'i sa bon bzhi bsam ste de zhu ba las spyi bor bde mchog lha lnga gsal btab pa nas bzung dbang bzhi pa'i bar 'og tu slob ma la ji ltar bya ba bzhin blangs/ de nas slob ma la bgegs gtor phyir dor/ maṇ+ḍal gsol btab nas bzung slob ma bde mchog tu bskyed pa la ye shes dbab pa'i bar sngar bzhin/ dngos gzhi'i slad du thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang ba zhu/ khyed rang gi spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba rnams su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re bsam pa'i steng du spyi bor hūm̐/ mgrin par hrīḥ snying gar hūm̐ rnams sngon po lte bar maṃ dmar ser/ spyi bo'i hūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las bde mchog lha lnga/ mgrin pa'i hrīḥzhu ba las mahā mā yā lha lnga/ snying ga'i hūm̐ zhu ba las dges mdzad lha dgu bskyed chog bzhin/ 'khor rnams mtshan tsam brjod pas kyang chog lte ba'i maṃ zhu ba las 'jam pa'i rdo rje dmar ser zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum 'jam pa'i rdo rje ma dang bcas pa/ de'i 'khor du rnam snang la sogs pa'i rigs bzhi/ spyan ma la sogs pa'i yum bzhi/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i lha mo drug

gshin rje gshed la sogs pa'i khro bo bzhi ste lha bcu dgu zhes pa'i tshig tsam mam bskyed chog rgyas pa brjod na'ang rung / de nas spyi bo'i lha tshogs la yid kyis mchod pa phul/ sku las 'od zer 'phros pas spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo 'od kyis khyab/ de la brten nas lus kyi sdig sgrib dag bum pa'i dbang thob snyam pa dang ḍā dril sogs 'dra/ yang mgrin pa'i lha la yid kyis mchod pa phul/ sku las 'od zer 'phros pas mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo 'od zer gyis khyab/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsang ba'i dbang thob snyam pa ḍā dril dang / oṃ āḥhrī hūm̐ swā hā/ byin rlabs 'dra/ yang snying ga'i lha la yid kyis mchod pa phul/ sku las 'od zer 'phros pas snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo khyab/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob snyam pa dang ḍā dril de wa pi tsu bzla ba sogs 'dra/ yang lte ba'i lha la yid kyis mchod/ sku las 'od zer 'phros/ sprul pa'i 'khor lo 'od zer gyis khyab/ lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa dag dbang bzhi pa thob snyam pa dang ḍā dril/ oṃ badz+ra dh+rig hūm̐ byin rlabs 'dra/ de ni bskyed rim gyi dbang bzhi yin/ zhu bde'i dbang la thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang ba zhu/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i lha tshogs 'od du zhu nas spyi bo'i nang thams cad gang bar bsam/ de bum dbang yin/ spyi bo'i 'od de mgrin pa'i lha la thim pas/ mgrin pa gang bar bsam/ de gsang dbang yin/ yang mgrin pa'i lha tshogs zhu nas snying ga'i lha la thim/ yang lte ba'i lha tshogs zhu nas lte ba man chad 'od kyis gang ste slar snying gar thim pa dang des snying ga'i lha tshogs rnams 'od du zhu zhing 'dres pas zag med kyi bde ba skyes te yid kyi sgrib pa dag pa'i mos pa gnang de sher dbang yin/ de ltar bde ba skyes pa de 'dzin med kyi ngang du bzhag nas sems ma bcos pa dar zhig 'jog pa zhu/

de dbang bzhi pa yin/ rmi lam gyi khyad par gyi byin rlabs ni khyed rang rnams bde mchog tu gsal ba'i smin mtshams su thig le dkar po sran ma tsam zhig gi nang du yi ge bdun pa kha dog sngon po 'od kyi rang bzhin khrug khrug pa la sems gtad la 'di rmi lam yin snyam pa'i dran 'dun re gnang ba zhu/ rjes gtso bos sogs nas yig brgya'i bar sogs 'dra// ༈ 'od gsal gyi dbang bskur ba'i tshe maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab bzhi lte ba ser/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / mchod gtor sngar bzhin bshams/ de nas slob dpon bde mchog lhan skyes su bskyed pa dang bzlas pa dkyus bzhin/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bde mchog lha lnga bskyed pa nas mchod pa dang gtor ma'i bar rigs 'gre/ mtshan sngags kyi tsakra saṃ bha ra maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri wa re sogs sbyar/ slob dpon rang gi spyi bor pad+ma 'dab bzhi lte ba dang bcas par bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bde mchog yab yum la snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhis bskor ba gsal btab pa nas dbang bzhi pa'i bar 'go nas 'byung ba bzhin blang / de nas slob ma la bgegs gtor nas bzung bde mchog tu bskyed la ye shes phab pa'i bar sngar bzhin dbang gi dngos po'i slad du khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi'i lte bar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bde mchog yab yum dang / 'dab ma bzhi la rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ de dag gi mtha' 'khor du dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa'i mos pa gnang la rang gi lus longs spyod dang dus gsum gyi dge rtsa thams cad rin chen sna bdun dang / phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa'i rnam par bsgyur nas de dag gi spyan snga na yar phul bas thugs mnyes par bsam/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ lan gsum/ spyi bo'i bla ma bde mchog gi sku las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phog pas de rnams kyi smin mtshams nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dkar po byung ste bla ma'i spyi bor thim/

bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi dkar po byung ste bdag gi spyi bor thim pas lus kyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas bde ba skyes bum pa'i dbang thob snyam pa'i ḍā dril dang yi ge bdun pa sogs 'dra/ yang sngar ltar mchod pas bla ma'i ljags steng nas 'od zer pad+ma rā ga lta bu byung ste rang gi lce thog tu thim pas ngag gi sdig sgrib thams cad dag nas bde ba skyes/ gsang ba'i dbang thob snyam pa'i sogs 'dra/ yang sngar ltar mchod pas bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer baiḍūr+ya'i mdog lta bu byung nas khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pas yid kyi sdig sgrib dag nas zag med kyi bde ba skyes shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob snyam pa sogs 'dra/ yang thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang ba zhu/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i bla ma 'khor bcas 'od du zhu rang la thim pas/ rang lus 'od du yal song ste/ rang sems 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po cir yang mi rtog pa'i ngang la dar zhig 'jog pa zhu/ des ni dbang bzhi pa thob pa yin/ ḍā dril sogs 'dra/ rjes gtso bos sogs dang / mdun bskyed la mchod brjod sogs 'dra// ༈ 'pho ba'i dbang bskur ba'i tshe maṇ+ḍal zlum skor la chos 'byung dmar po nyis rtseg gi gong ras ljang gu mu khyud nag po bya/ chos 'byung gi dbus su rdo rje sngon po gcig bris/ de'i steng mañdzi'i khar me long la sin+dhu ra'i chos 'byung nyis rtseg dbus su baṃ la oṃ āḥhūm̐ tshan pa gsum gyis bskor/ de'i phyi la a dgu bris/ zur drug la go cha'i sngags oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hṛṃ moṃ/ hṛṃ hṛṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa bri/ gong ras drug la g.yung drung 'khyil ba re bris te bzhag mchod gtor dkyus bzhin/ slob dpon gyis bdag bskyed bde mchog lhan skyes dang yi ge bdun pa bzla/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung nyis rtseg phyi dkar nang dmar ba bde bar rgyu zhing bde bar 'char ba 'od kyi rang bzhin can/

de'i nang du mi ro dkar po mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng na mkha' spyod ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang bcas pa/ zhabs gnyis bgrad pa/ ḍā ki ma'i 'khor gyis bskor ba de'i gnas gsum byin rlabs/ 'og min nas mkha' spyod ma spyan drangs la bstim/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi ni sa pā ri wa re re re'i dbur sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi nang mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ gtor ma byin rlabs la mtshan sngags kyi mthar i daṃ ba liṃ sogs lan gsum/ phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa sogs bya/ de nas rang gi spyi bor chos 'byung nyis rtseg phyi dkar la nang dmar ba bde bar rgyu zhing zhes pa nas dbang bzhi pa'i bar dang / 'pho ba'i khyad par gyi byin rlabs rnams 'og tu slob ma la ji ltar bya ba bzhin blangs/ de nas slob ma 'khod pa la me tog bskyed bsdu dang bgegs gtor dkyus bzhin maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab/ rgyun bshags/ slob ma bde mchog tu bskyed pa la ye shes dbab pa rnams snga ma dag gi rigs 'gros sbyar bas shes/ dngos gzhi la thugs 'dun dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gnang ba zhu/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor chos 'byung nyis rtseg ces pa nas ḍā ki mas bskor ba zhes pa'i bar mdun bskyed bzhin gsal btab/ de la gus pa dang bcas te dus gsum gyi dge rtsa lus longs spyod thams cad mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par bsgyur nas spyi bo'i mkha' spyod ma la yid kyis mchod pa phul/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i spyi bo'i mkha' spyod ma'i gsang gnas nas byang sems dmar la dkar ba'i mdangs chags pa byung nas spyi bor thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang /

lus kyi sdig sgrib dag bum pa'i dbang thob snyam pa'i mos pa gnang ba zhu/ ḍā dril bya zhing / oṃ gsum ma brjod/ yang yid kyis mchod pa phul la mkha' spyod ma'i gsang gnas nas byang sems dkar dmar khyed rang gi lce thog tu babs pas mgrin pa gang ste ngag gi sdig sgrib dag gsang dbang thob snyam pa'i mos pa dang ḍā dril sogs 'dra/ yang yid kyi mchod de gsang gnas nas byang sems dkar dmar khyed rang gi snying gar thim pas snying ga chos gyi 'khor lo gang ste yid kyi sdig sgrib dag lus sems la zag med kyi bde ba skyes/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa'i mos pa sogs 'dra/ yang mkha' spyod ma la yid kyis mchod pa phul bas mkha' spyod ma khyed rang gi spyi bor thim nas lte bar sleb pa dang / bde la stong pas khyab ste bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ngang la sems ma bcos pa dar gcig 'jog pa zhu/ des ni dbang bzhi pa thob pa yin/ ḍā dril sogs 'dra/ 'pho ba'i khyad par gyi byin rlabs kyi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gnang ba zhu/ khyed rang rnams bde mchog tu gsal ba'i dpung pa gnyis kyi steng du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhabs bzhag de'i gsang gnas pad+ma dmar po kha phye ba lta bu rang gi tshangs bug dang sprad pa'i rnam par gsal btab/ lte bar rang sems āḥdakar po 'phur la khad pa rgod kyi the thung lta bu rang rlung gi yom yom bskyod bzhin pa des gyen du bltas pas tshangs bug skya har re ba de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang gnas mthong / der 'gro ba'i bdun pa drag pos rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su khrid du gsol/ lan gsum/ rnal 'byor ma'i thugs kha nas 'od zer dkar po ba thag rkyang pa lta bu nar gyis byon/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lte ba'i a la reg pas khab len la lcags 'ju ba ltar 'then nas lus kyi dbus na yar ye re re song /

tshangs bug nas thon/ bha ga nas zhugs/ thugs khar sleb pa tsam la tog sgra dang bcas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nam mkha' la yed kyi byon/ blos 'khyud tshad du byon pa dang dag pa mkha' spyod du phebs par bsam/ rnal 'byor ma 'ja' yal ba ltar bsam/ ma rig pa brjod med du 'jog pa zhu/ ḍā dril dang oṃ gsum ma bya/ yang nam mkha' la sprin rdol ba bzhin rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lam gyis byon mar babs/ dpung pa'i steng du zhabs bzhag pa'i thugs kha nas rang sems a chad lte bar sleb/ yang gsol 'debs sogs gong bzhin ste dril bas tshar gsum mdzad/ mthar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nam mkha' nas lam gyis byon pa 'od du zhu/ spyi bo nas thim pas spyi bo sra zhing mkhregs pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsam/ rjes gtso bos sogs spyi dang 'dra/ 'og tu me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar zhes 'byung ba'i mkha' spyod dmar mo de dang gcig yin gsung / khyung po rang gis mdzad pa'i 'pho ba'i sgo nas bka' la 'di ka gsungs 'dug yang yig rnying 'ga' zhig tu 'pho ba'i sgo nas bka' la bde mchog lha lnga la brten pa'i dbang bzhi dang / slob ma bde mchog tu bsgom pa'i lte bar chos 'byung gi nang du yi ge a bsams nas spyi bo'i steng gi khru gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la pad nyi'i steng du bla ma dam pa bsgoms pa'i thugs khar a de bstim pa'i dmigs pa'i khyad par dang bcas pa bshad snang ngo // ༈ /drug pa bar do'i dbang bskur ni/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad phyogs bzhi dmar po/ me rlung ser po/ bden bral ljang gu/ dbang ldan sngon po/ lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la tshon spung sngon po re dgod/ mthar mchod gtor sogs bshams/ slob dpon gyis skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā wa sogs brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du rang skad cig gis he badz+ra sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yab rkyang bskyed/

byin rlabs ye shes pa bcug de wa pi tsu bzla/ mdun bskyed la dmigs te swa bhā wa brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes rang snang gi gzhal yas khang phyi dur khrod rdo rwa me ris bskor ba/ nang 'dab ma brgyad dang ldan pa'i dbus su pad nyi'i steng du he badz+ra yab rkyang / 'dab ma brgyad la bdag med ma gri thod can gzhon zhing sgeg pa bde ba rgyas pa brgyad bsam/ gnas gsum byin brlab/ ye shes pa'i lha dgu spyan drangs nas bstim/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi mchod nang mchod phul/ thams cad dngos po'i sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma byin brlab la mtshan sngags kyi mthar i daṃ bha liṃ ta kha kha khā hi lan gsum gyis phul/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang / bstod pa bya/ rang gi spyi bor pad 'dab lte ba dang bcas pa lha dgu bskyed pa nas dbang bzhi pa'i bar slob dpon rang nyid kyis blang / de nas slob ma bos la bgegs gtor sogs dkyus bzhin/ slob ma dges rdor du bskyed pa la ye shes dbab pa'i bar 'dra/ dngos gzhi ni slob ma'i spyi bor pad ma 'dab brgyad kha phye ba'i lte ba la he badz+ra dang 'dab ma brgyad la bdag med ma brgyad sngar bzhin gsal btab/ de la yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa dbul du gzhug bla ma rin po che bdag la zhes sogs kyis gsol btab gsum/ de nas spyi bo'i lha tshogs rnams las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa byung bas/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi phyi nang thams cad khyab pas las dang nyon mongs pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag lus snang la rang bzhin med pa 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ de'i ngang las khyed rang he badz+ra dpa' bo gcig par lam gyis gyur/ des bum dbang thob pa yin zhes brda sbyar la de wa pi tsu dang ḍā dril/ yang yid kyis mchod pa phul bas spyi bo'i bdag med ma brgyad gcig tu gyur nas yab la 'khyud pas yab yum bde ba rgyas te sbyor mtshams nas byang sems dkar dmar bde khri li li byung nas rang gi lce thog tu babs pas ngag gi sdig sgrib dag

bde ba skyes gsang ba'i dbang thob snyam pa'i mos pa byed du gzhug sngags dang ḍā dril/ yang mchod pas yum de las bdag med ma bde ba rgyas pa gcig chad nas byung ste bdag nyid yab tu gsal ba la 'khyud nas sbyor ba byas pas lus sems la zag med kyi bde ba skyes/ sems kyi sdig sgrib dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sngags dang ḍā dril/ yang spyi bo'i yab yum la yid kyis mchod pa phul bas lha yab yum gdan dang bcas pa 'od du zhu/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi gtsug nas thim pas rang nyid lha sku sngar bas kyang gsal bar gyur te lus lha sku gsal la rtog pa med pa'i zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la 'jog des dbang bzhi pa thob pa yin/ sngags dang ḍā dril bya/ yang khyad par gyi byin rlabs kyi slad du thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang ba zhu/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun du chos 'byung sngon po spang rgyan me tog kha phye ba lta bu'i nang du rang sems hūm̐ sngon po gcig tu bsgom mdzod/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gyi mngal gyi lan chags bag chags dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ snang srid thams cad dges rdor yab yum du lam mer gsal ba la rmi lam sgyu ma bar do'i dran 'dun re gnang ba dang / mthar 'dzin med du cham gyis 'jog pa zhu/ rjes gtso bos sogs 'dra/ sgos bka' 'di dag khrid kyi gnas skabs gang dang gang du bya ba ni dag byed a'i dmigs pa gsum song tshar nas thabs lam gyi khrid 'dzugs pa'i nyin mdun bskyed kyi shom rnams grub dang bstun/ slob mas yig brgya dang brgyud 'debs bya rin la slob dpon gyis thugs dam bsgrub pa'i rim pa rnams bya/ de nas sgos bka' bskur nas khrid 'dzugs/ de bzhin du sgyu lus sogs 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /'di dag khyung po'i yig rnying gzhir bzhag la/ /tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po yab sras kyi/ /gsung gi gsang ba zab mos brgyan te bkod/

/dang po'i las can rnams la phan gyur cig /de ltar ye shes mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs ni gu chos drug gi sgos bka' so so'i phyag len 'di ni rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi bran du gyur pa dge slong ngag dbang chos grags kyis chu mo bya'i lo spu dkar bla brang rdzong du go bde bklag chog tu bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni chos grags bzang po'o/ /'dis kyang tshar chen yab sras kyi bstan pa dri ma med pa yul dus phyogs kun du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ //'di'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 14 klu sgrub/ ni gu chos drug gi sgo nas bka' so so'i phyag len bzlas chog 5
